topic.title: Preferences
topic.shortdesc: Configure Git Client behavior using the preferences page contributed by the Git Client add-on.

body.p: The Git Client add-on contributes a preferences page to . To access it, go to Options Preferences Plugins Git Client , go to Git Settings Preferences , or use the Preferences action from the Git Staging view. This preferences page includes the following options:

li.p:
When detecting a Git repository inside a newly opened project - Determines what happens to the current working copy when a project that contains a Git repository is opened in the Project view. You can choose between:
Always switch to the new working copy
Never switch to the new working copy
Always ask (default value)
Notify me about new commits in the remote repository - Shows notification messages when new commits are detected in the remote repository. By default, this option is not selected.
Update all submodules after pulling changes from the remote repository - Updates all submodules when the repository is updated using a Pull operation. This option is selected by default.

ul.li:
Detect and open Oxygen projects (.xpr) from opened working copies - If this option is selected and a working copy that contains one or more project files (.xpr) is opened, the Git Client can open one of the projects. By default, this option is not selected.
If one .xpr file is found, it is opened automatically.
If more than one .xpr file is found and none of them are open, a dialog box lets you select the .xpr file to open.

li.p: Validate each file before committing - Validates each file to be committed. If validation problems are detected, the commit operation stops and a dialog box states that you can view the problems in the Git pre-commit validation tab of the Results area. If the Allow commit despite validation problems option is selected, the dialog box includes a Commit anyway button. This option is selected by default.
Validate all files from the project's "Main Files" folder before pushing - Validates the files in the Main Files folder before a push operation.

The following conditions are required for this option to work:
Main Files support must be enabled and the files must be added to the Main Files folder.
A validation scenario must be configured because the validation is based on it.
The current repository must be the same as the project loaded in the Project view and there must be no uncommitted changes. If uncommitted changes are detected, a dialog box offers to create a stash that is applied after project validation.

If validation problems are detected, the push operation stops and a dialog box states that you can view the problems in the Git pre-push validation tab of the Results area. If the Allow push despite validation problems option is selected, the dialog box includes a Push anyway button. This option is selected by default.

ul.li: Global Options/Project Options - If you select Project Options, the settings are stored in the project file (.xpr) so they can be shared with other users.

body.p:
The SSH Connections preferences page is under the Git Client preferences page. It includes the following option:
Use SSH agent - Uses the selected SSH agent to access the SSH keys already stored in it. On Linux, macOS, and BSD, the only supported agent communication mechanism is the usual communication through a Unix domain socket. On Windows, you can choose between:
Pageant
Win32-OpenSSH (default value)
